lines: You saw the sea split for you... would you ever bow to a statue? They did.
While Prophet Musa, alayhis salaam, was away forty nights, the Samiri made them a calf. And they said: This is your god.
Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech, nor harm, nor benefit?
Musa, alayhis salaam, returned and said: We will surely burn it, and blow it into the sea.
A god that can't answer you is no god. Turn to the One who answers.
